draft.tapeLabel: 文档摘要（Map-Reduce：分块子摘要再合并，适合大文档）
draft.tapeDescr: 业界经典模式二：按 batch_size 把切片分批，每批 LLM 生成子摘要，最后一批后把全部 子摘要合并出最终摘要。切片多的大文档用它，每批独立调用避免超上下文。产物=wiki 摘要页 + bindings.final_summary。

config.code:
chunks = bindings.get('chunks') or []
batch_size = int(bindings.get('batch_size') or 5)
cap = int(bindings.get('chunk_cap') or 2000)
batches = []
for i in range(0, len(chunks), batch_size):
    texts = []
    for c in chunks[i:i + batch_size]:
        t = (c.get('content') or '').strip()
        if len(t) > cap:
            t = t[:cap] + '…'
        if t:
            texts.append(t)
    if texts:
        batches.append({'idx': len(batches), 'text': '\n\n'.join(texts)})
bindings['batches'] = batches
bindings['_total'] = len(batches)
bindings['sub_summaries'] = []

batch = bindings.get('batch') or {}
idx = int(batch.get('idx') or 0)
total = int(bindings.get('_total') or 1)
bindings['is_last'] = (idx >= total - 1)
bindings['map_prompt'] = (
    '以下是文档的第 %d/%d 个片段，请生成 80~150 字中文子摘要，'
    '只输出摘要正文，不要多余解释：\n\n' % (idx + 1, total))
text = str(batch.get('text') or '')
bindings['map_prompt'] += text

subs = list(bindings.get('sub_summaries') or [])
s = str(bindings.get('sub_summary') or '').strip()
if s:
    subs.append(s)
bindings['sub_summaries'] = subs
if bindings.get('is_last') and subs:
    body = '\n\n'.join('[子摘要 %d] %s' % (i + 1, t) for i, t in enumerate(subs))
    bindings['reduce_prompt'] = (
        '以下是对同一文档各分段的子摘要，请合并为一份完整连贯的中文文档摘要'
        '（150~250 字，先一句话概括主题，再分点列出核心要点，只输出摘要正文）：\n\n' + body)
    bindings['merge_ready'] = True
else:
    bindings['reduce_prompt'] = ''
    bindings['merge_ready'] = False

config.code:
import hashlib
if bindings.get('merge_ready'):
    doc_id = str(bindings.get('document_id') or '')
    s = str(bindings.get('merged_summary') or '').strip()
    bindings['final_summary'] = s
    bindings['page_title'] = '文档摘要（Map-Reduce 分块合并）' if s else ''
    bindings['page_slug'] = 'doc-' + hashlib.md5(doc_id.encode()).hexdigest()[:10] + '-mapreduce'
    bindings['page_content'] = ('# 文档摘要（Map-Reduce 分块合并）\n\n' + s) if s else ''
else:
    bindings['page_title'] = ''
    bindings['page_slug'] = ''
    bindings['page_content'] = ''

        '以下是同一文档全部 %d 个子摘要：\n\n' % len(subs) + body +

        '1) 先一句话概括主题；\n'
        '2) 再分点列出核心要点，必须完整覆盖上述所有子摘要的全部要点，'
        '逐条合并、不得遗漏任何子摘要的内容；\n'
        '3) 不要输出任何标题（如『# 文档摘要』或『《文档名》文档摘要』等），直接输出摘要正文，不要附加任何说明、复述或多余文字。')
    bindings['merge_ready'] = True
else:
    bindings['reduce_prompt'] = ''
    bindings['merge_ready'] = False
